title: Parts Inventory page shows Bin Location, Category, Supply and Vendor filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Parts area and go to the Inventory page.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the parts table.
expected: 1. The Inventory page shows four filter buttons in a row: Bin Location, Category, Supply and Vendor (each with a small icon and a down arrow).
2. The table below shows the columns: Description, Part number, Tags, Category, Manufacturer, Vendor, Bin Location / Quantity and Action.
3. A blue New Inventory Part button is shown at the top right.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5 #1
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Which filters actually apply and their option lists are pending Branko's PRD.
